name: Limitless Fire
source:
A crimson shirt. A familiar mask. A debt long overdue. How do you like my warm welcome? Now it’s your turn to burn...

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=3898]lemmasoft[/url]]
translation:
深红色衬衫。熟悉的面具。一笔逾期已久的债务。你觉得我的热情欢迎怎么样？现在轮到你燃烧了……

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=3898]lemmasoft[/url]]
